description: Analyze one or more local SOC 2 report PDFs with trustlists (requires trustlists_login). First call uploads the files and returns a credit cost preview without charging. Call again with confirmCredits set to the returned total to queue the analysis. Results also appear in the trustlists app.

confirmCredits.description: Echo totalCreditsRequired from the preview to start the analysis.

filePath.description: Path to a SOC 2 report PDF.

name: trustlists_soc2_analyze
